    Frequently Asked Questions

    • Most video games recommend at least 3Mb/s download speed, but 15Mbps to 25Mbps will give you a much smoother gaming experience, reducing your game's ping rate.

      This will allow your gaming to be more reactive for perfectly timed moves and greater precision.

    • It's the delay between your action and the game's response. Much like lag, the lower it is, the better the game performs.

      Here's what your gaming experience might look like at different ping rates:

      Under 20ms - exceptional

      20 - 100ms - decent

      Over 100ms - poor

      Factors that contribute to high ping are slow download speeds, issues with your internet service provider, location, network congestion and router configuration.

    • Lag is the delay between a gamer's action and the server's reaction, and it might be why your online game appears slow.

      Low bandwidth and poor server processing power can be a cause. To improve it you need to look at reducing ping rate first.

    • The simple answer is, no. A typical family home may have ten or more devices all taking up bandwidth. As mentioned, Netflix is one of the greediest, far surpassing a typical online game.

      The higher your broadband's Mb/s, the more users can download and upload all at the same time at faster speeds.

      Our Ultrafast Plus package is ideal for even the busiest homes, with average download speeds of 500Mb/s.

    • Esports is competitive, organised gaming that has turned online gaming into a spectator sport.

      Amateur and professional gamers compete in tournaments for cash prizes, in games such as League of Legends, Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, Overwatch, Dota 2 and Call of Duty.

      At Sky, we’re powering Guild, the UK’s fastest growing professional esports team, with our ultra-reliable full fibre broadband technology, offering speeds 13x faster than our standard fibre broadband.

    Guarantees

    Speed Guarantee: Comes with any Sky Broadband and NOW Powered by Sky Broadband product. If the download speed to your Sky Hub drops below your guaranteed minimum download speed for three consecutive days or more, you will have the right to leave your broadband and Talk contracts without incurring early termination charges either at that point or within 30 days of us confirming that the issue can’t be resolved. You can also upgrade your broadband product without any upfront fees.

    This applies anytime within your minimum term. Total loss of service and Major Service Outages do not count towards three-day periods, such as if your broadband stops working completely, or you can’t use the internet on any of your devices and it’s not a WiFi problem. Speed checks must be done using sky.com/servicechecker, the MySky app or by speaking to one of our service advisors. See sky.com for more details, usage policies and to check your speeds.

    WiFi Guarantee with Boost: Available to new Ultrafast customers and as a re-contract for existing customers with Sky Broadband Boost. Min. 3Mb/s - Sky engineer's visit required to confirm WiFi speed - or money back and you can cancel your Sky Broadband Boost subscription without any early termination charges. Claim once anytime during 24-month min. term. Money back will be one month of your broadband and Sky Broadband Boost subscriptions credited to your Sky account. This excludes Sky Talk, call charges, and any other Add-Ons like McAfee. One claim per address. Claim only valid if using Sky router and booster(s). See sky.com/boostwifi. Not available with Sky Broadband Essential Plus.

    WiFi Max Guarantee: Requires any Sky fibre or NOW Powered by Sky fibre product and WiFi Max. Min. 10Mb/s for Sky Broadband Superfast 35, Superfast, Full Fibre 75, Full Fibre 100, NOW Superfast Powered by Sky, NOW Full Fibre 75 Powered by Sky, and NOW Full Fibre 100 Powered by Sky. Min. 25Mb/s for Sky Broadband Ultrafast, Full Fibre 150, Full Fibre 300, Full Fibre 500, Full Fibre Gigafast, and NOW Full Fibre 300 Powered by Sky - Sky engineer's visit required to confirm WiFi speed - or money back and you can cancel your WiFi Max subscription without any early termination charges. Money back will be one month of your broadband and WiFi Max subscriptions credited to your Sky account. This Guarantee does not cover gardens or any external rooms, buildings or structures such as sheds or garden offices. Claim once anytime during 24-month min. term after first 14 days and when paying for broadband. One claim per address. Claim valid only if using Sky Max Hub and Sky Max Pod(s) and Device Priority is switched off. See sky.com/help/articles/enhanced-wall-to-wall-wifi-guarantee.
